newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BRUSSELS BOURSE ENDS BUSY DAY PUSHED LATE INTO RED.
newsitem.headline: BRUSSELS BOURSE ENDS BUSY DAY PUSHED LATE INTO RED.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Bel-20 index .BFX ended Friday nearly half a percent lower as a late avalanche of block trades pushed the market down after spending most of the day with light gains ahead of the three-day weekend.
* Bel-20 index ended 11.00 points or 0.49 percent down at 2,240.30, with 11 losers, five unchanged and four gainers. Total of 8.5 billion francs of Belgian shares changed hands.
* Bekaert (81,000 shares) and BBL (188,000 shares) busiest issues by value, ending unchanged at 21,100 francs and 8,930 francs respectively. Barco main loser, down 2.6 percent to 6,370 francs
